scope: Only direction-consistent normal CMD17/18/24/25 with data and !tuning_running; includes associated SBC and error-stop commands. Initialization and tuning excluded. Background ordinary block I/O is included.
preserved: coherent bounce allocation and full payload copies
both mandatory DMA reset fences, error paths, ownership checks and quarantine

segments.dispatch: request-side timestamp immediately before queue_work to worker-side sample start after eligibility check
segments.worker_service_before_done: worker sample start through all command handling until immediately before completion bookkeeping
segments.dma_start: entire t736_dma_start call, including nested pre_reset and write_copy; do not sum these nested values
segments.pre_reset: mandatory t736_dma_stop at beginning of dma_start
segments.command_wait: before IRQ clearing/argument/command submission through poll-loop completion; includes hardware, sleep and scheduling, not device-only time; SBC/data/error stop are separate invocations
segments.post_reset: mandatory t736_dma_stop after completed/failed data transaction
segments.read_copy: sg_copy_from_buffer call after dma_rmb; includes possible interrupts/scheduling
segments.completion_callback: mmc_request_done call only; no request/data access after it
segments.worker_total_before_merge: worker sample start through completion return; excludes final aggregate lock/update and function entry/exit bookkeeping

aggregation.capacity_policy: Any overflow/invalid segment/backwards clock discards whole sample from totals; incomplete_samples/dropped_events visible. Actual request success path needs well below capacity.
aggregation.counts: attempted/success/failed, requested/completed bytes, size bins <=4K/<=16K/<=64K/>64K by read/write; poll iterations and sleep attempts have no per-poll timestamps
aggregation.segment_fields: calls, total_ns, lifetime max_ns; max is not subtractable
aggregation.cpu_fields: segment start/end counts, same-endpoint count/ns per CPU0..7 and other bucket8; different-endpoint count/ns per segment; compare raw CPU ids before bucketing
aggregation.cpu_limits: Same endpoints do not prove no migration. Different endpoints prove at least one migration, not residency or number of migrations. Brief get_cpu/put_cpu brackets each endpoint timestamp only.
aggregation.overhead: All added wall timestamp/counter work is gated by default-off activation/eligible request; timing instrumentation and final merge overhead can affect diagnostic-on measurements.
aggregation.snapshot_lifetime: normal debugfs_create_file protected open proxy covers copy; snapshot owns all later seq state; remove removes debugfs before host free; no snapshot host dereference after open
aggregation.snapshot_boundary: contains only samples merged after completion callback; user wake may precede last merge. Take stable after snapshot and reconcile counts; adjacent /proc/probe/debugfs windows are not identical.

validation.actual_C_aggregation: ASan/UBSan PASS: nested segments, multi-command request, failed DMA, CPU other-bucket, whole-sample overflow/invalid-clock/invalid-segment
validation.ARM64_external_module: PASS against frozen v24 build; compile-only artifact, not intended for board
